recorded_chain_rule.name: recorded-action-four-executions-v2
recorded_chain_rule.accept: Action-first divergence with identical recorded prefix; two run-kind and two replay-kind executions; exactly three full chains and physical outcomes equal.
recorded_chain_rule.refuse: Two run executions versus two replay executions, every other grouping, non-action first divergence, unavailable further execution, or ceiling exceeded.
recorded_chain_rule.run_path: Actual engine JobMode.run in independent oracle scratch run, not a replay substitute.
recorded_chain_rule.ceiling: Smallest k with Poisson(n * upper_rate).sf(k) < .001; n counts deduplicated second-execution calls only.
recorded_chain_rule.coverage: All scoring baselines plus observed baselines whose removal outcomes are used. Experiment off by default; optional whole observed/experiment verification.
recorded_chain_rule.partial_coverage: Ceiling pending until named window complete; partial coverage cannot make measured truth complete.
recorded_chain_rule.legacy_resume: Completed replay files and saved replay-kind third reused, missing run-kind fourth added; finalized unproven first pass reproved from files before scheduling.
recorded_chain_rule.canonical: Settled majority supplies oracle/scorer baseline, original world records unchanged.
recorded_chain_rule.rate_interval: Exact 95% Clopper-Pearson interval per comparison opportunity, as before.
recorded_chain_rule.residual: Once-executed changed replays remain exposed; fixed upper rate times maximum steps bounds expected affected rows, full-window point bounds and Markov 95% bounds per scoring/observed table.

late_regressions_before_repair.after: All cases pass in final focused run.

truth_file.items: faults[] and pairs[] retain curve_class beside measured_class, eligibility, qualified_by and windows.{scoring,observed} counts/net/points/status.
truth_file.consumer_guard: complete must be true; report embeds measured_causes and shows both lists.
truth_file.class_rule: Standalone >=2 fleet points in either window; eligible interaction only if neither member qualifies alone; additive pairs excluded. Decoy/inert promotions use scoring only; data faults count logged/true mismatches without replay.
